title: Live Animal Department Sale Standards by Guarantee Type
content:
Each live animal sold under the Live Pet Health Guarantee is sold to the standards set for its guarantee type: the youngest age of the purchaser of record, whether a habitat appropriate to the species must be on record at purchase (bought or confirmed by staff), the largest number of animals on one purchase, the days the store holds the animal before sale, and what the customer is given at purchase.

## Purchaser, habitat and quantity

| Guarantee type | Youngest purchaser of record (years) | Habitat appropriate to the species on record at purchase | Largest number of animals per purchase | Days the store holds the animal before sale |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | 16 | Yes | 24 | 3 |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | 16 | Yes | 12 | 7 |
| Live Coral Guarantee | 16 | Yes | 6 | 7 |
| Small Animal Guarantee | 18 | Yes | 4 | 7 |
| Bird Guarantee | 18 | Yes | 2 | 14 |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | 18 | Yes | 2 | 14 |

## Given at purchase, and the stocking guideline

The stocking guideline is the figure used at the habitat check, in inches of fish per gallon; 0 means the guideline does not apply to the type.

| Guarantee type | Species care sheet given | Drip or float acclimation instructions given | Stocking guideline (inches of fish per gallon) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | Yes | Yes | 0.5 |
| Live Coral Guarantee | Yes | Yes | 0 (not applicable) |
| Small Animal Guarantee | Yes | No | 0 (not applicable) |
| Bird Guarantee | Yes | No | 0 (not applicable) |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | Yes | No | 0 (not applicable) |

## Points of judgement

- **Age boundary.** The figure is the youngest age allowed, so a purchaser of record aged exactly 16 may buy fish or coral, and one aged exactly 18 may buy a small animal, bird, reptile or amphibian; a purchaser of 17 may buy under the three aquatic types but not under the other three.
- **Quantity boundary.** A Bird Guarantee purchase may include 2 birds and not 3; a Freshwater Fish Guarantee purchase may include 24 fish and not 25.
- **Stocking guideline, hypothetical habitat.** At 1 inch of fish per gallon, a 20-gallon freshwater tank corresponds to 20 inches of fish; at 0.5 inch per gallon, a 20-gallon saltwater tank corresponds to 10 inches of fish.
- **Acclimation instructions** are part of the sale for the three aquatic types only.
